issue.description:
GitHub 原始規格：[https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/issues/75](<https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/issues/75>)

## 定位

<issue id="defcab2f-3dc9-42a2-967d-9435975958a8" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-5/perception-pipeline-vnext感知流程升級">VID-5</issue> 是 Perception Pipeline vNext 的父任務 / roadmap，不對應單一 PR。子階段全部完成後才移 Done。

## 最終進度

* Phase 1：已完成並合併
* Phase 2：已完成並合併
* Phase 3：<issue id="94bf11b8-041e-4f9c-93f8-d5967a69f125" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-8/phase-3專案級故事理解">VID-8</issue> 已完成；PR #81 已合併，merge commit `56aff213e5a70e26c9ad11bf9f72905540bb9d7a`
* Phase 4：<issue id="f254db03-72f0-4451-ba96-ce8d20a07d19" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-9/phase-4低信心雲端複判">VID-9</issue> 已完成；PR #82 已合併，merge commit `9744c1c5c02611c8ea6300f4b6295c23b62af854`
* Phase 5：<issue id="0da7ea31-db57-43cf-be85-1407407fdffe" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-10/phase-5音訊感知">VID-10</issue> 已完成；PR #83 已合併，merge commit `f30e77df59b78a809951f6348a4dec3de82316fc`

**Perception Pipeline vNext 全部 Phase 已完成，**<issue id="defcab2f-3dc9-42a2-967d-9435975958a8" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-5/perception-pipeline-vnext感知流程升級">VID-5</issue> **已 Done。**

## 執行前狀態驗證規則（強制）

開始任何新 Phase、建立 branch、判定 blocked/unblocked、Ready 或 Merge 前，必須先讀取即時系統狀態，不可只依賴描述文字、舊 comment、cached context 或先前回報。

狀態來源優先順序：

1. GitHub PR / branch / commit 即時 metadata（state、merged、draft、head_sha、base、CI checks）
2. Linear issue 即時 status / relations
3. PR body、Linear description、comments、歷史紀錄只作說明，不可單獨作為 blocker 判定

若文字敘述與即時 metadata 衝突，以即時 metadata 為準，並先同步修正 Linear / PR 說明後再繼續。

每個新 Phase 開始前固定執行：

* `git fetch origin`
* 確認前置 PR `merged=true`
* 確認最新 `origin/main` 已包含前置 merge commit
* 從最新 `origin/main` 建立新 Phase branch
* 禁止從上一 Phase branch 開 stacked PR，除非 Linear 明確允許

## Codex → Review 交接規則（強制）

Codex 不得在只有本機 commit / local tests 完成時回報「完成」「可 review」或等同語意。交接給 ChatGPT review 前必須同時滿足：

* 專用 branch 已 push 到 GitHub，遠端 branch 可由 GitHub metadata 查到
* 已建立對應 Draft PR，base 必須是最新 `main`，不可 stacked
* PR body 已包含本次實作範圍、HEAD SHA、測試/CI evidence、source media / production data 是否修改
* Linear 子任務已留下 handoff comment，至少包含 PR URL、branch、HEAD SHA、CI/evidence 與已知未完成項
* 若 required CI 尚在跑，可以回報「已送 review、CI pending」，不可回報「完成」
* 若尚未 push / 尚未建 PR，即使 local tests 全綠，Linear 必須維持 `In Progress`，不得要求 ChatGPT review

ChatGPT 收到使用者「跑完了 / done / 好了」時，先以 GitHub 即時 metadata 驗證上述 handoff；若不存在遠端 branch/PR，視為交接未完成，不得根據本機口頭回報判定 PASS。

## Review / Merge 狀態規則

* 開發中：Linear `In Progress`、PR Draft
* 最終 review PASS：Linear `In Review`、PR Ready
* Review PASS 後優先啟用 GitHub Auto-merge；若 PR 已是 clean、GitHub 不接受 enable auto-merge，則在 required checks 全綠且 reviewed HEAD 未變動時，以 expected HEAD SHA 鎖定後直接 merge
* GitHub 實際 `merged=true` 後才將該 Phase Linear issue 移 `Done`
* 下一 Phase 只有在前置 PR 即時 metadata 已確認 merged 後才開始

## 共通原則

* local-first
* stable IDs / human override 不得被自動流程破壞
* 不修改 source media 或 production user data
* cloud 能力必須 optional、可稽核並有成本/隱私邊界
* AI 輸出只提供 recommendation；真正影響剪輯的變更需走明確 Apply / review 流程

Linear 作為 roadmap 與任務狀態入口；GitHub 即時 metadata 是 PR/branch/merge/CI 狀態的權威來源。GitHub Issue #75 保留完整歷史規格與 phase evidence。

issue.title: 本機環境健檢｜Doctor + WebUI 系統狀態
issue.description:
GitHub 原始規格：[https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/issues/77](<https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/issues/77>)

## 目標

建立一個可稽核、預設唯讀的本機健康檢查入口，並讓 WebUI 使用同一份結構化報告顯示系統狀態。

## 實作範圍

* 提供 `video-vault doctor`、`--quick`、`--full` 與 JSON export。
* 建立版本化的 `pass / warning / blocked / skipped` result contract。
* 檢查 runtime/media、Node/HyperFrames、SQLite/library、AI provider、asset/configuration。
* `--full` 只使用隔離 temporary fixture，不修改 production data。
* WebUI 新增「系統狀態」頁，直接消費相同 backend report。

## 驗收條件

* 缺少 dependency、provider offline 等情況必須有明確 fail / skip 語意。
* 敏感路徑、secret、API key 必須去敏。
* Doctor 不得自動安裝套件、修改設定或下載模型。
* Windows、Ubuntu portability、Frontend tests/build 通過。

## Codex 使用方式

先讀這張 Linear Issue；只有需要更細的 implementation detail 或 attribution 規則時才讀 GitHub #77。

VID-6 / PR #84 final long-path blocker 已修正並更新 handoff。

PR： https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/pull/84（維持 Draft）
Branch：agent/vid-6
HEAD：25b039b178a08faaf14a38d49c6714e4c1077768

本輪變更：
- 移除單一 300+ 字元 directory component。
- 改用至少四層一般長度的 nested directories。
- fixture component safety limit = 180；regression 同時驗證 total path > 260 與每個 generated component <= 180。
- evidence 新增/保留 long_path_threshold、long_path_length、max_component_length。
- Windows 只有 actual mkdir + copy + read/content verification 全部成功才 pass；失敗為 blocked/warning 且 verified=false。
- 非 Windows 維持 skipped/not_verified，不宣稱 Windows capability。
- 其他 VID-6 修正未變更。

Evidence：
- Targeted Doctor/CLI/HyperFrames：40 passed。
- Full Python：592 passed、2 skipped。
- Required CI #31296644662 全綠（Frontend、Media Smoke/Ubuntu、Ubuntu Python 3.13、Windows Python 3.11、selector）。
- 本機 Windows fixture：threshold=260、total length=327、max component=59。主機在 mkdir 回 FileNotFoundError，因此如實 blocked/warning；未偽造 pass。
- Source media unchanged；production user data modified = No。

### ChatGPT review — CHANGES REQUIRED (round 3)

PR #84 / HEAD `dcbc53c8a6b2abf92f0d75ba5c61d0bf017d239f`

Round 2 blockers 1–3 are fixed correctly and CI `31294504302` is green. One correctness blocker remains:

**Windows long-path fixture is testing an overlong single path component, not total-path > MAX_PATH.**

Current code constructs:
`fixture_root / ("long-path-" + ("nested-" * 45) + "測試")`

That creates one directory component around 300+ characters long. Windows long-path support can raise the total path above 260, but an individual path component is still normally limited to 255 characters. Therefore this probe can fail even on a machine where long paths are correctly enabled, and can never reliably distinguish MAX_PATH support from the per-component filename limit.

Required fix:
- Build a total path > `_WINDOWS_LONG_PATH_THRESHOLD` using **multiple normal-sized nested directory components**, each safely below the filesystem component limit.
- Record `long_path_threshold`, total `long_path_length`, and preferably `max_component_length` in evidence.
- On Windows: only `pass` if total path > threshold and the actual mkdir/copy/read operation succeeds; otherwise `blocked`/warning.
- On non-Windows: keep `long_path_status=skipped/not_verified` and never claim Windows capability.
- Regression must assert total path > threshold **and every generated component remains <= the chosen safe component bound**.

Keep all other current fixes unchanged: production `database.init_db()` migration fixture, render/library-volume disk threshold, optional false/malformed config handling, recursive redaction, H.264/AAC Unicode fixture, HyperFrames offline/no-install, provider/story checks, single-check rerun, loopback-only, no production writes/paid calls.

Keep VID-6 `In Progress` and PR #84 Draft. After this fix rerun targeted Doctor tests + full Python + required CI and update handoff.

VID-6 round-2 correctness blockers 已修正並完成 review handoff。

PR： https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/pull/84（維持 Draft）
Branch：agent/vid-6
HEAD：dcbc53c8a6b2abf92f0d75ba5c61d0bf017d239f

本輪完成：
- full SQLite fixture 改為 legacy/older schema + production database.init_db()，驗證 columns/backfill/index/rollback/cleanup，不再以 current SCHEMA 自我驗證。
- free-disk 拆分 OS temp 與實際 render/library（library_root/99_exports）volume，minimum_free_disk_bytes 套用於 render volume；補 C:/D: different-volume regression。
- false/no/0/off 統一 false；disabled BGM/retention skipped；malformed enabled boolean/numeric 回 structured blocked、不 crash。
- Windows long-path 實際嘗試 >260 path，記錄 threshold/actual length/status；本機 OS 對 length 415 回 FileNotFoundError，因此如實為 blocked/warning；非 Windows 會 skipped/not_verified。
- 保留 recursive redaction、真 CJK H.264/AAC、HyperFrames offline/no-install、provider/model/story、single-check、loopback-only、no production writes/paid cloud calls。

Evidence：
- Full Python：591 passed、2 skipped。
- CI-equivalent non-media：556 passed、2 skipped、35 deselected。
- Doctor/CLI/HyperFrames targeted：39 passed。
- Frontend：36 files、249 passed；production build passed。
- Required CI #31294504302 全綠（Frontend、Media Smoke/Ubuntu、Ubuntu Python 3.13、Windows Python 3.11、selector）。
- Isolated CLI/WebUI acceptance 使用 temporary root；SQLite production migration check、render free-disk check、WebUI root/security/full doctor/single-check 均完成；redacted JSON 的 sensitive_data_redacted=true 且無 temp-root leakage。
- Source media unchanged；production user data modified = No。

### ChatGPT review — CHANGES REQUIRED (round 2)

PR #84 / HEAD `d18a90284b6c0a2f0068dd9dc5a09a1655014f88`

Previous blockers are substantially fixed and required CI `31271651473` is green. Four correctness blockers remain before merge:

1. **`storage.sqlite` does not actually test the production migration path.**
   - Current fixture imports raw `SCHEMA`, executes it directly, extracts required tables from that same string, and hard-codes `schema_contract_version=database-schema-v1`.
   - Production startup uses `database.init_db()`, which also runs `_ensure_columns`, legacy BGM migration, stable-ID/media backfills, indexes, etc. The current check can pass even when those migrations are broken.
   - Required: build an isolated legacy/older-schema fixture, run the real `init_db()` migration path, then verify required columns/indexes/backfills/rollback and cleanup. Do not claim migration/version consistency from a SCHEMA-vs-itself check.

2. **`runtime.free_disk` checks the wrong filesystem for render readiness.**
   - It always calls `disk_usage(tempfile.gettempdir())`, then compares that C:/temp (or equivalent) free space to `render.minimum_free_disk_bytes`.
   - The library/render/output may live on another volume (e.g. D:). This can falsely block when temp is low but render volume is healthy, or falsely pass when temp is healthy but render volume is full.
   - Required: keep a separate temp-volume free-space check if useful, but evaluate render/storage threshold against the actual configured library/render/output filesystem (or the same path contract production render uses). Add cross-volume regression.

3. **Disabled optional asset settings can be treated as enabled, and malformed retention can crash Doctor.**
   - The repository YAML parser currently leaves `false` as the string `"false"`; `_asset_checks()` uses `bool(bgm.get("enabled"))` / `bool(retention.get("enabled"))`, so explicit `enabled: false` becomes truthy and may be falsely blocked.
   - `float(...)` conversion for retention policy runs inside eager `_asset_checks()` and can raise before `_timed()` catches it, so malformed config can crash the whole CLI/API instead of returning structured `blocked`.
   - Required: use normalized boolean semantics (`false/no/0/off` => false), validate numeric policy fail-closed into a Doctor check, and ensure all malformed asset/config values produce structured results rather than exceptions.
   - Regression: YAML `bgm.enabled: false` and `retention.enabled: false` => skipped; malformed enabled retention numeric => structured blocked, no crash.

4. **Windows long-path probe still does not prove a Windows long-path condition.**
   - The path is created by repeating `nested-` 18 times, but there is no assertion/guarantee that the final path exceeds the Windows MAX_PATH-risk range; the test only checks that the copy succeeded.
   - A normal temp base can leave this path below ~260 chars, yet `long_path_verified=true` and the media check can pass.
   - Required: on Windows intentionally construct a path above the chosen long-path threshold (record threshold + actual length) and verify the actual operation. On non-Windows, report Windows long-path as `skipped`/not verified rather than claiming a Windows capability. Add threshold regression.

Existing fixes must remain green: recursive redaction, real CJK H.264/AAC fixture, HyperFrames no-install/offline probe, provider/model/story checks, single-check rerun, loopback-only UI, no production writes/paid cloud calls.

Keep VID-6 `In Progress` and PR #84 Draft. After fixes rerun full Python, targeted Doctor regressions, frontend/build, required CI, isolated CLI/WebUI acceptance, and update handoff evidence.

VID-6 review handoff completed.

- PR #84: https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/pull/84
- Branch: agent/vid-6
- HEAD: d18a90284b6c0a2f0068dd9dc5a09a1655014f88
- PR remains Draft; not merged/Ready.
- Scope completed: recursive safe evidence/report redaction; real Unicode + H.264/AAC/long-path/temp/free-disk probes; HyperFrames offline no-install formal probe; mock/local/cloud/Story Provider matrix; SQLite/library/assets/config checks; shared CLI/API/WebUI check contract with per-check rerun and redacted export.
- Full Python: 587 passed, 2 skipped.
- Frontend: 36 files / 249 passed; production build passed.
- Required CI run 31271651473: Frontend, Media Smoke/Ubuntu, Ubuntu Python 3.13, Windows authoritative Python 3.11, Select PR test layers all passed.
- Isolated CLI quick/full JSON and media single-check acceptance passed available probes; full report correctly marks local Python 3.10 and missing HyperFrames node_modules as blocked, never pass.
- WebUI per-check rerun/merge/redacted export regressions and UI static/security acceptance passed.
- Source media unchanged; production user data modified = No; no installs/downloads/config mutation/paid cloud requests.

### ChatGPT review — CHANGES REQUIRED

PR #84 / HEAD `069cf63a35a46e97bf470bb6425d969ee597bbdf`

Handoff is valid and required CI `31268554939` is green, but VID-6 is **not merge-ready**. The implementation covers the Doctor/report/UI skeleton, but GitHub #77 is explicitly the detailed implementation contract and several Definition-of-Done items are still missing or falsely reported.

Confirmed blockers:

1. **`sensitive_data_redacted=true` is not enforced on `evidence`.**
   - `_check()` redacts `summary` / `remediation`, but does `clean_evidence = dict(evidence or {})` and returns it unchanged.
   - WebUI renders `JSON.stringify(check.evidence)` and JSON export returns the same object.
   - Therefore any future/current evidence containing an absolute path, token, URL credential, filename, or secret leaks while the report claims it is redacted.
   - Required: recursive redaction/sanitization at the report boundary for nested dict/list/string values and sensitive key names; `sensitive_data_redacted=true` only when that invariant is actually enforced.
   - Regression must inject nested path/token/API-key/Authorization values into evidence and assert API/WebUI/export payload contains none of them.

2. **Full media/runtime probe does not satisfy #77 and currently makes a false Unicode capability claim.**
   - `_media_fixture_check()` uses `unicode fixture.mp4`, which is ASCII-only, but reports `unicode_path: true`.
   - It encodes `mpeg4` + AAC, so it does not verify the required H.264 capability.
   - #77 also requires Windows long-path risk, temp-directory writability, and free-disk checks; these are absent.
   - Required: real CJK/Unicode path fixture, H.264 + AAC capability evidence (or explicit blocked/skipped if unavailable), temp/free-space check, and Windows long-path risk result. Never claim a capability that was not exercised.

3. **`--full` HyperFrames check is only a file-presence check, not a behavior test.**
   - `_hyperframes_check()` only checks `package.json` and `node_modules`; it is identical in default/quick/full.
   - #77 explicitly requires full-mode HyperFrames behavior validation plus offline/formal-subprocess contract, while preserving no auto-download.
   - Required: isolated/non-production behavior probe in full mode; quick/default must clearly distinguish presence/import sanity from behavior-tested capability.

4. **AI provider health is too shallow to support the #77 provider contract.**
   - Local provider passes on any 2xx `/models`; configured model existence, provider/model contract, vision/multi-image capability are not validated.
   - Active cloud provider passes on API-key presence alone; unsupported cloud provider/model/config is not fail-closed.
   - Enabled cloud-review is only reported as warning and does not validate whether its configured provider/key/contract is usable (without making a paid call).
   - Story provider is not represented at all even though it is an enabled AI subsystem.
   - Required: auditable checks for each enabled provider subsystem, model/config contract and required capability; cloud remains config-only/no paid request; unsupported capability must blocked/skipped correctly.

5. **The remaining #77 check matrix / WebUI DoD is incomplete.**
   - Storage/library: add migration-version consistency and configured inbox/project/render/cache availability (without modifying production data).
   - Configuration/assets: validate lockfile parseability, enabled LUT/BGM/retention requirements only when applicable; disabled optional assets must remain skipped.
   - WebUI: #77 requires rerun **single check or all checks**; current page only reruns quick/full whole reports.
   - Add the specified fault-injection regressions: missing Node, missing node_modules, SQLite unavailable/unwritable/isolation failure, local provider offline/model missing/capability missing, plus recursive redaction and individual rerun.

Existing good behavior must remain:
- quick: no real FFmpeg/Node subprocess;
- full writes only isolated OS-temp fixtures and cleans them;
- production library/source/user data untouched;
- cloud checks never issue paid requests;
- loopback-only WebUI boundary remains enforced;
- pass/warning/blocked/skipped and exit-code semantics remain stable.

Keep VID-6 `In Progress` and PR #84 Draft. After fixes rerun full Python, targeted Doctor/provider/storage tests, frontend full + production build, required CI, and isolated CLI/WebUI acceptance; update PR + Linear handoff evidence.

- Local evidence: full Python `578 passed, 2 skipped`; targeted doctor/CLI `14 passed`; frontend `36 files / 248 tests passed`; production `npm run build` passed; `git diff --check` passed.
- Required CI run `31268554939`: all green — Frontend; Windows authoritative PR Core/Targeted Python 3.11; Ubuntu portability PR Core/Targeted Python 3.13; Media Smoke Ubuntu; Select PR test layers.
- Isolated acceptance root: `C:\Users\b3b3b\AppData\Local\Temp\vid6-acceptance-20260809`; CLI quick/full/JSON and live WebUI `/system-status` HTTP 200 + `/api/doctor?mode=quick` schema/mode/redaction checks passed. Full fixture probes passed.

GitHub 原始規格：[https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/issues/78](<https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/issues/78>)

## 目標

在 approved render 與人工最終交付之間加入獨立、可稽核的 Delivery QA 階段。

## 實作範圍

* 建立版本化 QA run / check schema，使用 `pass / warning / blocked / skipped` 語意。
* 自動檢查 container/manifest、black/flash、freeze/silence、border/crop、audio 與 continuity。
* travel / coffee / matcha diary 使用 profile-aware thresholds。
* 產生 QA evidence bundle：contact sheet、event strip、metrics、stable segment UUID reference、output fingerprint。
* WebUI 提供最終 delivery gate；Automatic QA 不取代人工 final preview。

## 驗收條件

* 所有非 pass finding 都要有 evidence 與 remediation context。
* `skipped` 不得偽裝成 success。
* `blocked` 在問題修復或重新評估前不得成為 `deliverable_ready`。
* source media、approval snapshot、user override、production data 均保持不變。
* Windows 真實輸出 smoke、FFmpeg E2E、Frontend tests/build、Ubuntu portability 通過。

## Codex 使用方式

先讀這張 Linear Issue；需要完整檢查矩陣、profile threshold 或 attribution 細節時再讀 GitHub #78。

## 已完成主體

* Versioned Creator Profile
* `travel_diary` / `coffee_matcha_diary` / `roasting_diary` / `general_diary`

* Open-source attribution：concept inspired by `Hao0321/video-autopilot-kit` commit `f081e99ed169b5aba1156a2aa6a80b748c39fbc9`; Code adapted from: None

## 目前 confirmed hardening blockers

 1. **Recovery-on-read**：一般 Story GET / project polling 不可呼叫 destructive recovery，把仍在執行的 generation 誤標 `interrupted`。Recovery 只能放在明確 startup/recovery boundary。
 2. **Stale generation Apply**：Apply 前必須重新計算 current `StoryInputSnapshot`；舊 generation 的 `input_hash` 不等於目前 input 時必須 fail closed，不能用新的 request revision 套用舊故事。
 3. **Duplicate suppression**：目前 validator 要求所有 included segment 全部出現在 chapter，與 duplicate suppression 衝突。需加入明確 `suppressed_segments` contract 與 representative 驗證。
 4. **Stable chapter identity**：Human review 必須保留 App 配置的 `chapter_id`；client 不可偽造 ID；rename/reorder 不得改 chapter identity。
 5. **Creator/Profile concurrency**：Creator Profile 與 Project Story Settings 不應綁在同一半原子 API；no-op 不增 version；stale write 409；Story settings 不得在尚未 Apply 前提早使 render approval 失效。
 6. **StoryInput privacy / provenance**：模型 input 不應使用 filename/display-name 作語意來源；需真正整合既有 `story_context.py` 的 user summary、negative guidance 與 provenance。
 7. **WebUI dirty draft**：polling refresh 不得覆蓋尚未儲存的 Creator / settings / chapter 草稿；需沿用現有 workspace dirty / navigation guard 契約。
 8. **WebUI 完整度**：補 Creator 全欄位、Project Story Settings、可視化 segment cards/reorder/move、chapter transition/title card/notes、raw/normalized/effective audit、stale state、suppression evidence。
 9. **Calibration production wiring**：目前只有 helper；需真正從 valid approved storyboard / approval snapshot / render metadata 收集 user-owned calibration records，並提供 WebUI recalc/reset。
10. **Publish rollback**：story current pointer 與 generation `succeeded` 必須形成一致 publish boundary；故障/取消不得讓 failed/publishing generation 成為 current。
11. **Local provider audit/retry**：strict schema、最多一次 corrective retry；記錄 call count / retry / per-call latency / total latency；仍只傳 text JSON。
12. **Real acceptance**：Windows Travel + Coffee/Matcha 多 clip、實際 LM Studio local text model、WebUI人工 lock/regenerate/stale/apply/calibration 尚待完成。

## Merge gate

只有以下全部完成才能將 PR <pull-request id="67821eaf-8759-4216-9fc0-b12d9595f951" href="https://linear.app/videoai/review/issue-75-phase-3-project-level-story-understanding-2f819e5a09e6">DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai#81</pull-request> 改 Ready：
